value.deck: Microsoft has integrated MAI-Code-1.1-Flash into GitHub Copilot, offering an updated AI code model and a transition path as its predecessor approaches deprecation.
shortVersion: GitHub Copilot now supports MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, a direct upgrade to the existing MAI-Code-1-Flash model. This integration provides developers with an updated AI code generation backend, which is expected to offer enhancements in code quality and generation performance within the Copilot ecosystem. The rollout establishes a clear migration path for users reliant on the previous iteration.

The introduction of MAI-Code-1.1-Flash is particularly timely given the impending deprecation of MAI-Code-1-Flash. This proactive update ensures continuity for developers, mitigating potential disruptions in their AI-assisted coding workflows. The change log explicitly states its availability, confirming the immediate operational shift for Copilot users.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub Copilot now uses an updated AI model, MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, to improve code suggestions and provide a smooth transition from the older version.
